(b) Pearl India Ltd. is a major packaged food company which dominates in 1+1+3
some sectors like snacks, diary, biscuits and instant meals. It offers
high quality and unique products that match the taste and preference of
the customers. It always takes steps to enhance brand image and charge
a premium price for which buyers do not negotiate. Often the unique
features of their products that are not available with their competitors
help them to gain competitive advantage. Hence, using this strategy,
today Pearl India Ltd. is consistently gaining its position in the industry
over its competitors.
Identify and explain Michael Porter's generic strategy being followed
by Pearl India Ltd. to gain competitive advantage. What are the
disadvantages of following such strategy ?
